answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 200 slots; agents bid sealed deposits. Like climbers on a karst ridge, one path in, each step costs. Top 200 bids win a jade seal; deposits lock 20 epochs, returned only for honest behavior; losers refunded at once. An attacker wanting 50 fake identities must outbid honest agents 50 times: at a typical 400 POA bid that is 20,000 POA locked for one epoch of rewards. Honest agents pay once, keep their deposit.
